gaps: Official result-certification date and the first sitting are not transcribed; election dates and seat counts reuse the verified national dataset.
Mid-term consultation positions, mandate deadlines and extensions are incomplete unless an explicit step below records them.
Closing date is the next election, not dissolution day. The governing dissolution/election-date law has not been retrieved; regular versus early termination is not inferred from term length.
Individual days of the October 1950 Ben-Gurion–Rosen–Ben-Gurion tasking sequence have not been recovered.

Replacement-coalition snapshots are partial: government 14’s faction splits and current seat counts require a separate audit. Other replacement snapshots use election-list seats with stated support-list limitations.
